composesExisting: src/memory/item7-stage-d-memory-sync.ts (StageDFencingStore / StageDSyncAdapter / StageDRecoverySink interfaces + syncMemoryAssets, imported type-only, unmodified)
note: Stage D persistent-sync builds the durable, cross-process infrastructure the CR1 technical slice explicitly deferred (its default in-memory fencing + recovery sink were valid for the dark slice only). It adds a persistent O_EXCL/CAS fencing + completion store, a persistent auditable recovery-receipt store that halts on write failure and blocks a resource until an operator explicitly resolves it, a local-only staging -> hash-verify -> atomic-publish adapter, and a dark shadow/canary that runs the controlled local-only sync against an ISOLATED fixture and does a read-only identity comparison. It does NOT retire the three P8 syncMemoryFiles call-sites (S33/S34/S35), does NOT modify the canonical retirement scan or its count, does NOT switch production sync, and does NOT enable cloud/BYOS. Production stays legacy-only; the controlled write path is shadow-only.

persistentStorePropertiesProven: controlled placement root (resolveStateDir()/data-governance/stage-d-sync); the caller never supplies a path, only tenant/resource/operation identity which is validated and hashed into governed filenames
atomic exclusive acquire via fs.openSync(path, 'wx') (O_EXCL) — exactly one process across the system wins the same fence
held record carries full identity: fenceKey + operationId + fencingToken + state + createdAt + updatedAt
same operation + same fencing token re-acquires (crash resume); a stale token is rejected (stale_token)
a completion record persists the full identity (operationId+tenantId+sourceResourceId+destinationMode+manifestSha256+classification) and replays across a process restart
recovery_required is a durable resource block that survives restart and is NEVER cleared by release() — only an explicit operator resolveRecovery lifts it (no automatic stale takeover)
recordRecoveryRequired halts on durable write failure (the throw propagates; the block is not falsely recorded)
legal hold forbids physical staging/held cleanup on resolve (block lifted for audit closure, artifacts preserved)
operationId is validated with assertSafeRecoveryReceiptToken (fail-closed on ':' '/' '..'); receipts store a governed relative staging ref, never an absolute host path
localOnlyAdapterPropertiesProven: custodian 'device'; supportsMode returns true only for local-only; every non-local mode (encrypted-cloud/tenant-cloud/dedicated/byos/cold-archive) is refused

copy stages under a controlled root keyed by a validated operationId, writes source content, recomputes the staging manifest hash from the bytes actually written, and verifies it equals the source manifest BEFORE publishing
atomic publish via rename (staging -> published) on the same filesystem
any failure (copy exception, staging hash mismatch, publish failure) leaves staging QUARANTINED, publishes nothing, and returns partial:true so the caller records recovery_required and halts
no double-write: a second copy of an already-published operation is refused (already_published_no_overwrite)
no host-path fallback; a raw/escaping source path is refused (unsafe_source_relpath / staging_path_escape)

shadowCanaryScope.darkGated: runs only under the Item 7 W1 dark dual-read flag (isItem7W1DarkDualReadEnabled); production default is a no-op (returns null)
shadowCanaryScope.mismatchBehavior: quarantine=true, production continues legacy-only, no automatic Catalog correction, auditable mismatch receipt written
